📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough This PR reclassifies img2table (and its numpy/pillow/polars dependencies) as base engine dependencies preinstalled before node activation, updating requirements.txt files accordingly. depends.py gains AVX2 CPU detection logic (Darwin/Linux/Windows) that injects polars-lts-cpu into combined requirements and excludes standard polars from uv installs when AVX2 support is missing. ## Changes **OCR Dependency and AVX2-aware Install** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Requirements file updates for base OCR dependencies**
`nodes/src/nodes/ocr/requirements.txt`, `nodes/src/nodes/requirements.txt`|OCR node requirements.txt notes that numpy, pillow, and img2table are base engine dependencies and removes their explicit entries; parent requirements.txt adds img2table under a new OCR base dependencies section.| |**AVX2 detection and polars-lts-cpu injection**
`packages/server/engine-lib/rocketlib-python/lib/depends.py`|Adds \_is_x86_64_missing_avx2() using sysctl/proc/cpuinfo/IsProcessorFeaturePresent checks; \_combine_requirements() scans for img2table/polars and injects polars-lts-cpu when AVX2 is missing; \_write_excludes_file() excludes standard polars from uv installs in that case.| ## Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant NodeActivation participant DependsPy participant AVX2Detector participant UVInstaller NodeActivation->>DependsPy: request combined requirements DependsPy->>AVX2Detector: _is_x86_64_missing_avx2() AVX2Detector-->>DependsPy: AVX2 status alt AVX2 missing and img2table/polars present DependsPy->>DependsPy: inject polars-lts-cpu DependsPy->>UVInstaller: excludes list includes polars else AVX2 present DependsPy->>UVInstaller: excludes list without polars end UVInstaller-->>NodeActivation: dependencies installed ``` ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes ## Poem > A rabbit checked the CPU's core, > No AVX2? I'll add some more: > polars-lts-cpu, hop right in, > exclude the old, let the new begin. > img2table now lives up front, > no more mismatched native hunt! 🐇✨
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 5

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
